# LeagueSphere

> LeagueSphere is a web platform for organizing flag-football league play: gameday schedules, live scores, league standings, team rosters, and officials assignments. Page content is primarily in German; this file and the JSON API use English labels.

LeagueSphere serves amateur flag-football leagues. League administrators plan gamedays, referees report scores live via a liveticker, and fans follow results and league tables. Key facts:

- Domain: leaguesphere.app
- Sport: American flag football (Germany)
- Core entities: seasons, leagues, gamedays, games, teams, officials
- Live data: scores update in near real time during gamedays
- Language: German UI, English API labels

## Public pages

- [Gameday overview](https://leaguesphere.app/gamedays/): all league gamedays with dates and status
- [Liveticker](https://leaguesphere.app/liveticker/): live-updating scores for today's games
- [League table](https://leaguesphere.app/leaguetable/): standings per league and season
- [Gameday detail](https://leaguesphere.app/gamedays/gameday/{id}/): schedule, results, and progress of one gameday
- [Team roster](https://leaguesphere.app/passcheck/team/{id}/list/): public roster of a single team
- [Officials assignments](https://leaguesphere.app/officials/einsaetze/): referee assignments per gameday

## Machine-readable data

- [API: Liveticker](https://leaguesphere.app/api/liveticker/): JSON live scores, no authentication, cached ~60 seconds
- [API: Gamedays](https://leaguesphere.app/api/gamedays/): JSON, paginated list of gamedays, no authentication
- [API: League table](https://leaguesphere.app/api/league-table/{league}/): JSON standings per league (and optional season)
- [Dynamic data guide](https://leaguesphere.app/llms-dynamic.txt): how fresh each endpoint is, and when results are final
- [For agents](https://leaguesphere.app/agents.md): welcome file and navigation guide for AI agents
- [Full reference](https://leaguesphere.app/llms-full.txt): extended descriptions of every page and API endpoint
